title: The G-ring property passes from an affine open cover to every affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ be an affine open covering. If every ring $\mathcal O_X(U_i)$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then for every affine open $V\subseteq X$ the ring $\mathcal O_X(V)$ is a G-ring.
